external.name: memo
external.description: Main entry point. Runs watch mode by default, monitoring file changes and updating .memo/index

external.name: memo watch
external.description: Watch mode - continuously monitors files, updates index on changes. Default command. Handles SIGINT/SIGTERM for graceful shutdown.

external.name: memo scan
external.description: Scan mode - analyzes all files once, updates index, then exits. Useful for CI.

external.name: memo mcp
external.description: MCP mode - starts JSON-RPC 2.0 server over stdio for AI agents to query index. Requires existing index.

external.name: MCP JSON-RPC server
external.description: In mcp mode, accepts initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call requests and returns JSON-RPC responses on stdout

external.name: memo_list_keys
external.description: MCP tool: Lists keys at a JSON path in .memo/index. Returns {type: 'dict'|'list', keys?: [...], length?: N}. Includes whenToUse guidance in description.

external.name: memo_get_value
external.description: MCP tool: Gets JSON value at a path in .memo/index. Returns {value: '<JSON string>'}. Includes whenToUse guidance in description.

external.name: .memo/index/*.json
external.description: Output files containing semantic index of codebase. Updated by watch/scan modes, read by mcp mode.

external.name: MOONSHOT_API_KEY
external.description: Kimi API key for AI analysis. Used by kimi-agent-sdk. Can also be set in config.yaml.

external.name: config.yaml
external.params: YAML with log_level, watch.ignore_patterns, watch.debounce_ms, watch.max_wait_ms, agent.api_key, agent.model
external.description: Optional configuration file. Loaded from project root or specified with -c flag.

external.name: .memo/status.json
external.description: Analysis status file. MCP server reads this to warn about stale data during analysis.

external.name: .memo/.history
external.description: Debug log file for MCP requests/responses and watcher events. Append-only.

external.name: .memo/watcher.lock
external.description: Exclusive lock file to prevent multiple watcher instances on same directory.

external.name: .memo/mcp.json
external.description: Local MCP config file. Prevents kimi-agent-sdk from loading ~/.kimi/mcp.json (avoids infinite recursion).

external.name: SIGINT/SIGTERM
external.description: Watch mode handles these signals for graceful shutdown. Resets status to 'idle' and releases lock.

internal.name: cmd.Execute() error
internal.description: Entry point for Cobra CLI. Parses args, dispatches to watch/scan/mcp commands.

internal.name: cmd.SetVersion(v string)
internal.description: Sets version string displayed in --version and banner.

internal.name: cmd.LoadConfig(path string) (*Config, error)
internal.description: Loads config from YAML file. Returns default Config (not error) if file not found.

internal.name: cmd.Config.MergeGitignore(workDir string) error
internal.description: Loads .gitignore from workDir and merges patterns into config.Watch.IgnorePatterns.

internal.name: analyzer.NewAnalyser(agentCfg AgentConfig, workDir string) *Analyser
internal.description: Creates Analyser with deterministic session ID from workDir hash. Uses embedded prompts/*.md.

internal.name: analyzer.Analyser.Analyse(ctx context.Context, files []string) error
internal.params: ctx: context; files: absolute file paths
internal.description: Analyzes files in batches (max 100 per batch, split by directory). Sets status to 'analyzing', validates JSON, retries up to 5x.

internal.name: analyzer.NewWatcher(root string, ignore []string, debounceMs, maxWaitMs int, onChange func([]string)) (*Watcher, error)
internal.params: root: directory; ignore: patterns; debounce/maxWait: timing in ms; onChange: callback
internal.description: Creates filesystem watcher with fsnotify. Uses semaphore for concurrent analysis guard.

internal.name: analyzer.Watcher.ScanAll()
internal.description: Walks directory tree, adds all non-ignored files to pending set.

internal.name: analyzer.Watcher.Flush()
internal.description: Non-blocking: acquires semaphore, stops timers, calls onChange with pending files. Skips if analysis running.

internal.name: analyzer.Watcher.Run() error
internal.description: Enters fsnotify event loop. Returns on watcher close or error.

internal.name: analyzer.ValidateIndex(indexDir string) ValidationResult
internal.description: Validates all JSON files against embedded schemas. Returns {Valid: bool, Errors: []string}.

internal.name: analyzer.TryLock(memoDir string) (*os.File, error)
internal.description: Acquires exclusive lock. Platform-specific: flock (Unix), LockFileEx (Windows). Writes PID to lock file.

internal.name: analyzer.Unlock(f *os.File)
internal.description: Releases lock and closes file.

internal.name: analyzer.SetStatus(memoDir string, status string) error
internal.description: Writes status.json. Includes 'since' timestamp when analyzing.

internal.name: analyzer.GetStatus(memoDir string) Status
internal.description: Reads status.json. Returns 'idle' if file doesn't exist or is invalid.

internal.name: analyzer.PrintBanner(opts BannerOptions)
internal.description: Prints ASCII art banner. Adapts to terminal width (full/compact/minimal). Shows update notice if available.

internal.name: mcp.Serve(workDir string) error
internal.description: Starts MCP server reading stdin, writing stdout. Blocks until EOF.

internal.name: mcp.NewServer(workDir string) *Server
internal.description: Creates MCP server with history logger. Sets up stdin reader and stdout writer.

internal.name: mcp.ParsePath(path string) (file string, segments []PathSegment, err error)
internal.description: State machine parser with escape support. Returns file name and segments. Validates against allowedFiles whitelist.

internal.name: mcp.ListKeys(indexDir, path string) (*ListKeysResult, error)
internal.description: Returns {type: 'dict'|'list', keys?: [], length?: N} for value at path.

internal.name: mcp.GetValue(indexDir, path string) (*GetValueResult, error)
internal.description: Returns {value: '<JSON>'} for value at path.

internal.name: internal.SetLogLevel(level string)
internal.description: Sets global log verbosity. Default: info (level 2).

internal.name: internal.LogError(format string, v ...any)
internal.description: Logs error message (level >= 0). Also writes to historyLog if initialized.

internal.name: internal.LogWarning(format string, v ...any)
internal.description: Logs warning message (level >= 1). Used for non-fatal issues like broken symlinks.

internal.name: internal.LogInfo(format string, v ...any)
internal.description: Logs info message (level >= 2). Used for general progress info.

internal.name: internal.LogDebug(format string, v ...any)
internal.description: Logs debug message (level >= 3). Detailed debugging output.

internal.name: internal.InitHistoryLogger(memoDir, source string)
internal.description: Initializes global historyLog. Closes any existing logger first.

internal.name: internal.CloseHistoryLogger()
internal.description: Closes global history logger and sets to nil.

internal.name: internal.NewLineBuffer(timeout time.Duration) *LineBuffer
internal.params: timeout: flush timeout for partial lines
internal.description: Creates buffer for clean streaming output. Flushes complete lines immediately.

internal.name: internal.LineBuffer.Flush(force bool) string
internal.params: force: if true, flush all; if false, only complete lines or on timeout
internal.description: Returns content to output. Trims trailing newlines on force flush.

internal.name: internal.CheckUpdate(currentVersion string) *UpdateInfo
internal.description: Synchronous GitHub API check with 2s timeout. Returns nil if no update or error.

internal.name: internal.CheckUpdateAsync(version string) <-chan *UpdateInfo
internal.description: Async GitHub API check. Returns channel with UpdateInfo or nil.

internal.name: internal.NewHistoryLogger(memoDir, source string) (*HistoryLogger, error)
internal.description: Creates JSONL logger to .memo/.history. Thread-safe with auto-incrementing sequence.

internal.name: internal.HistoryLogger.Log(entry HistoryEntry)
internal.description: Writes JSONL entry with seq, timestamp, source. Thread-safe via mutex.
